title: Driving World Models Move the Camera, Not the Scene

output_modality.value: single-view front-camera video forecasts (24-frame evaluation arms, 36-frame rollouts, 576x1024) from frozen released generators

control_signal.value: ego plan: speed plans (0.5x, 1.5x of logged speed, braking, stopping) and lateral shifts (0.54 m up to 3.5 m)

control_mechanism.value: Released models embed the plan as tokens. ReTime-Compose is training-free: retimes the model's own logged-speed rollout, splats frames to planned cameras using depth and poses, frozen generator completes uncovered pixels, Difix3D+ refiner

base_model.value: Frozen released generators Epona (main), GEM, Orbis 2; DrivingWorld also probed; VGGT depth, RAFT plus PnP pose chain, Difix3D+ single-step refiner

datasets.value: KITTI, nuScenes and Argoverse 2; validation set plus five test sets, 212 contexts from 43 drives

metrics.value: scene response alpha and noise N against retimed LiDAR or stereo disparity; scale-aligned ADE; KID and Frechet distance on DINOv2 features for image quality

controllability_evidence.value: Released models reach at most about a third of real-video scene response under speed plans; ReTime-Compose reaches .93-1.04 of real stereo response for a 0.54 m shift on KITTI; speed response gains +.17 and +.16 over re-sampling

closed_loop.value: No; closed-loop planning with these forecasts is stated as still to be tested; open-loop evaluation over 24 plan steps

stated_limitations.value: Retiming covers static content under speed plans and lateral shifts up to 3.5 m; not turns, lane changes or other agents' reactions; needs a rollout reaching planned poses and a working pose reading

notes: Mainly a diagnostic and evaluation paper on plan-conditioned world models; the proposed method is an inference-time wrapper, not a new conditioned generator. Family label is a judgement call.
